summary: Pretending a systemic power struggle is just a communication issue will keep you spinning your wheels against someone who holds all the leverage.
body: Pretending a systemic power struggle is just a communication issue will keep you spinning your wheels against someone who holds all the leverage. When Mars opposes Pluto, visible hustle runs straight into structural gatekeeping, money, authority, or institutional rules you cannot charm your way around. Identify who holds the actual keys, assess what leverage you genuinely retain, and decide if the fight is worth the cost or if you need to completely change your approach.
